svg.text: Priority cascade — what pre-empts what
Evaluated top to bottom; the FIRST branch that matches wins. Order is the design: a surrounded man
breaks before he goes to ground, and an AT team never charges infantry.
1 · CREW-onfoot
crewman whose vehicle is gone — breaks contact, not a rifleman
2 · MOUNTED / CREW-defer
in a vehicle, or a pilot/gun crew — defer wholly to base AI
3 · ROUT / ROUT-cover
outnumbered AND bloodied — evaluated ABOVE pinned, on purpose
4 · AT-stalk / AT-hunt
AT team acquires an enemy vehicle — barred from the assault below
5 · ASSAULT / ASSAULT-cover
aggressive doctrine, close range — above PINNED or it can never fire
6 · PINNED
engine's own isSuppressed() — go to ground and shout
7 · MEDIC-sortie / MEDIC-hold-cover
sorties only when the sortie is survivable
8 · DRAG-approach → pickup → to-cover
exactly one man elected from the roster; no messages
9 · RADIO-fire-mission
stalled radioman calls a barrage; phase script may refuse it
10 · LEADER-cover
leaders direct from cover and never walk point
11 · SUPPORT-hold-fire
the LMG IS the base of fire — it holds, it does not rush
12 · ADVANCE-behind-armour
line abreast behind a friendly hull
13 · BOUND-move / BOUND-overwatch
half the roster moves, half watches — swaps every 8 s
14 · FIGHT-from-cover
threatened, nothing better — let the engine pick the cover
No contact:
DEFEND-hold (defenders never get move orders — measured, they ignore them) ·
CONSOLIDATE on captured ground · RALLY-on-MG · ROAD-MARCH in staggered file
Order matters: ASSAULT and ROUT both sat BELOW pinned once and were structurally unreachable — measured at 9 fires in 10,731.
